summary: This directory manages the core analysis and structural construction of TypeScript packages, providing mechanisms to resolve exports, identify dependencies, and generate formal conceptual models of a project's architecture.
responsibilities: Analyze project package exports and source structures
Resolve export targets to concrete file paths
Construct and manage package conceptual models
relationships: The package analysis process relies on export resolution to identify relevant source files for inclusion in the package concept.
Package concepts represent the processed structural data which is persisted to the file system for future retrieval.
Dependency collection provides context to the package analysis by mapping external requirements against the project configuration.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of internal logic from public APIs
Separation of concerns between resolution logic and reporting
Centralized type definitions for analysis data structures
